answer_1.quote: Abstractive summarization models aim to generate a shorter text sequence as the summary of an input document.

answer_2.quote: We use ROUGE as the automatic evaluation metric for performance comparison. More specifically, we report the F1 scores of ROUGE-1/2/L in our experiments.

answer_4.quote: we conduct human evaluation for the coherence of system-generated summaries on GovReport dataset... We randomly sampled 30 examples from the test set of GovReport, and counted the number of text spans containing the coherence errors in the summaries generated by PageSum and LED. All examples are annotated by three of the authors.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators identified span-level coherence errors using a fine‑grained taxonomy (Missing Information/Reference, Abrupt Topic Transition, Inconsistent/Conflicting Information, Repetition).
